context: A teacher walks a uni student through a public-affairs paper
purpose: Teach: 内科/洪水/断片/正統/腐敗/駐在/車線/開花

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮くん、レポート読んだよ。テーマは地方政治の腐敗だったね。
lines.en: Ren, I read your report. The theme was corruption in local politics, right?
lines.style: Warm professorial opening, sets the tone gently.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。県庁に駐在している記者の方々に取材して、証言を中心にまとめました。
lines.en: Yes. I interviewed reporters stationed at the prefectural office and centered it on their testimonies.
lines.style: Earnest student tone, slightly nervous but prepared.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 視点は面白い。ただ、引用が会話の断片みたいに浮いてる箇所があるの。
lines.en: The angle is interesting. But some quotes float like fragments of conversation.
lines.style: Constructive criticism, measured academic delivery here.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ああ、確かに。前後の文脈を切りすぎたかもしれません。
lines.en: Ah, true. I may have cut too much surrounding context.
lines.style: Self-aware acknowledgment, humble undergraduate register here.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: それと第三章、洪水被害の予算流用の話、ここは正統派の論証で攻めるべき。
lines.en: And chapter three, the flood-relief budget misuse part, attack it with orthodox argumentation.
lines.style: Sharper teaching mode, pointing at specific section.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: わかります。感情論より制度の問題として書き直します。
lines.en: I understand. I'll rewrite it as an institutional issue rather than emotional argument.
lines.style: Committed response, showing growth and acceptance.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: あと健康面、大丈夫?先週、内科に行ったって言ってたよね。
lines.en: Also, your health, okay? You said last week you went to internal medicine.
lines.style: Sudden caring shift, mentor-like personal concern here.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: もう平気です。帰り道、車線を間違えるくらいぼんやりしてましたが、今は集中できています。
lines.en: I'm fine now. On the way back I was so out of it I took the wrong lane, but I can focus now.
lines.style: Light self-deprecating anecdote, natural student humor here.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 気をつけてね。この論文、君が研究者として開花するきっかけになるかもしれないよ。
lines.en: Be careful. This paper might just be the spark for you to blossom as a researcher.
lines.style: Encouraging closing, warm faculty mentorship tone here.
